reasoning: The evidence shows that as of early 2026, the Pentagon shifted from threatening to recall Kelly to active duty for court-martial to instead pursuing administrative penalties (demotion and reduced retirement pay). Hegseth initially threatened recall but opted for administrative action instead. Kelly filed a lawsuit challenging this, with a hearing in February 2026. The judge indicated he would rule on a preliminary injunction by February 11, 2026. The evidence consistently shows the Pentagon chose administrative penalties over recall to active duty. With less than a month until April 1, 2026, and the Pentagon having already chosen the administrative route rather than recall, it appears unlikely Kelly will be recalled to active duty before the deadline.
